messages.subject: Licensing our quantum sensing patents — instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to speak yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the proposed licence of our quantum inertial sensing patents (the VQ family) to Marrick Defence Systems. It's an exclusive, field-limited deal for defence and aerospace only — we keep everything else.

Could you send an engagement letter and a first view on structure? Priyanka (CTO) will be your technical contact; Martin (CFO) handles the numbers.

Best,
Elaine

Dr Elaine Crawford | CEO, Veridian Photonics Limited

messages.subject: RE: Licensing our quantum sensing patents — instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Elaine,

Delighted to help. Our engagement letter is attached. James Osei will lead day to day, with Elena Marchetti supporting; I'll stay close on the commercial and warranty points.

On structure, I'd suggest a full patent and know-how licence: an upfront fee, a milestone on first commercial sale, and a running royalty, with the field carefully drawn so you retain everything outside defence/aerospace. We'll coordinate the patent-status questions with Hartington IP.

Please sign and return the letter and we'll get moving on heads of terms.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner — Corporate / IP

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
